messages:
Rae (marketing): Need a crisp external one-pager tying deploy modes to SLA + inbound routing for field. Short, scannable.
Sam (product): Target: platform teams + security/compliance. Core points: data controls, predictable latency, cost predictability.
Iris (eng): Public-safe benchmark line: "Typical verified p95 (2k gen): Hosted ~270ms, Dedicated ~200ms (reserved), Private: varies; contact us for workload tests." Keep wording careful.
Vik (field): Routing rules: form tags -> secure_eval / sla_query / private_request. secure_eval -> AE-security; private_request -> solutions-eng + open support ticket. Flag gov/healthcare/finance as high priority.
Noor (design): I'll build a 1-page PDF: hero micro-table (Hosted | Dedicated | Private), three icons (SLA, KMS/audit, VPC), and a slim benchmark strip. Deliverable by EOD tomorrow.
Rae (marketing): Webinar concept: "From Benchmarks to Contracts: Practical SLA Patterns". Speakers: Sam + Iris + customer. CTA on one-pager: Download PDF, Request PoC, Register.
Sam (product): Add a 5-step migration checklist: 1) Compliance scoping 2) Pick deploy mode 3) Baseline perf 4) Request benchmark 5) Canary rollout + monitor.
Iris (eng): Throughput note we can show publicly: Dedicated with autoscale supports ~650 reqs/min at 512-token average. Cost ballpark for 1M tokens: $75-$115 depending on quant/profiles.
Vik (field): SDR/AE play: Email 1 - one-pager + quick value; Email 2 - benchmark tease + webinar; Call - offer benchmark/PoC. CRM tag: secure_eval. Create Slack alert to #sales-ops for priority leads.
LegalBot: Reminder: submit any SLA language to #legal-review before publishing.
Rae (marketing): Action items: Iris - confirm public benchmark line; Noor - mock by EOD tomorrow; Vik - routing matrix + CRM automations; Sam - finalize checklist + webinar plan. I'll draft external copy v1 and post here for review.
Sam (product): Keep external copy conservative and include: "Results measured on representative workloads; contact us for tailored benchmarks."
Noor (design): Will include small architecture sketch showing fallback routing (Dedicated -> Hosted) for graceful degradation.
Vik (field): I'll also prepare a short discovery template for AEs: compliance needs, data residency, throughput targets, SLA expectations.
Rae (marketing): Keep the page under ~350 words. We iterate here. :rocket:
